categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in smart logistics and intelligent manufacturing system integrated solutions, providing automated production lines and logistics systems planning, system integration, software development, equipment customization, electrical control system development, installation, commissioning, training, and after-sales services. It serves industries including new energy, petrochemical, tobacco, machinery manufacturing, aerospace, automotive, power, biomedicine, food and beverage, fresh cold chain, large supermarkets, communication electronics, and home daily chemicals. The business also includes intelligent software and hardware products such as industrial IoT platforms, digital twin platforms, warehouse management systems, logistics collaborative management systems, production execution systems, equipment management systems, and intelligent logistics equipment like AGVs and stackers. Additionally, the company offers after-sales operation and maintenance services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages industrial internet technologies, AI, edge computing, digital twin, IoT, industrial robots, laser scanners, RFID, and big data to develop smart logistics and intelligent manufacturing systems. It employs a rapid response R&D mechanism focused on autonomous development, including a digital integration platform, AI models, and low-code platforms. Production methods include customized procurement of machinery, computer hardware/software, and in-house assembly of electrical control equipment. The company integrates software and hardware to provide comprehensive automation solutions, with continuous innovation in intelligent control systems, digital platforms, and automated testing tools.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large and medium-sized enterprises across over 40 industries, including new energy, petrochemical, tobacco, machinery manufacturing, aerospace, automotive, power, biomedicine, food and beverage, fresh cold chain, large supermarkets, communication electronics, and home daily chemicals. The company serves manufacturing and logistics enterprises seeking automation, digitalization, and intelligent transformation of production and logistics processes. The customer base includes well-known large enterprises, with a significant portion of orders from traditional industries and expanding into new potential sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant market presence in East China, Central China, South China, North China, Southwest, Northwest, and Northeast regions. It has also expanded overseas with subsidiaries in Hungary and Singapore, achieving notable order growth in Europe and Southeast Asia. Overseas orders accounted for 20.40% of total orders in 2024, showing a 172.36% year-over-year increase. The company plans to further develop its global business network and enhance international market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly as a midstream integrator and solution provider in the smart logistics and intelligent manufacturing supply chain. It designs, integrates, and delivers comprehensive automation systems combining software, hardware, and services. It procures customized equipment and components from suppliers and assembles electrical control systems internally, positioning itself as a system integrator and technology innovator rather than a pure upstream manufacturer or downstream end-user.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on technological innovation in smart logistics and intelligent manufacturing, emphasizing digital transformation and industrial internet platforms. Key R&D initiatives include developing the Today International Industrial Internet Platform, AI-driven equipment cloud management, digital twin platforms, intelligent control systems, and integrated logistics platforms. The company invests in productization, expanding intelligent software and hardware product lines, and enhancing autonomous R&D capabilities. It also pursues internationalization and sustainable development aligned with national industrial upgrading and digitalization policies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through customized system integration projects for smart logistics and intelligent manufacturing solutions, involving large-scale contracts typically acquired via bidding. The company also sells intelligent software and hardware products, either bundled within projects or independently. Additionally, it earns revenue from after-sales operation and maintenance service contracts. Payment terms are milestone-based, with staged payments linked to contract signing, equipment delivery, project acceptance, and warranty periods.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading integrated solution provider in China's smart logistics and intelligent manufacturing sector, with over 20 years of experience and a strong reputation for high-quality service. The industry is highly competitive with increasing concentration among top players and intensified competition from traditional equipment manufacturers transitioning to intelligent solutions. The company differentiates itself through comprehensive capabilities, multi-industry expertise, and expanding overseas presence. It faces competition from domestic and international firms in intelligent warehousing, robotics, and industrial automation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.37 billion, representing a 22.51% decrease year-over-year, mainly due to macroeconomic fluctuations and reduced downstream investment. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 276.43 million, down 28.80%. Despite revenue decline, new orders increased by 7.25% to RMB 2.54 billion, with overseas orders growing significantly. Total assets stood at RMB 4.53 billion, with a stable financial position and an asset-liability ratio of 62.70%. The company maintains a solid R&D investment ratio around 6% of revenue and continues to expand its order backlog.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering fully integrated, customized smart logistics and intelligent manufacturing solutions that enable clients to achieve automation, digitalization, and intelligent management across production and logistics processes. Its value proposition includes high-quality project delivery, comprehensive one-stop services from design to after-sales, advanced technology integration, and strong industry experience across diverse sectors. The company leverages proprietary platforms, AI, and industrial internet technologies to enhance operational efficiency, reduce costs, and improve management transparency for customers. Its commitment to innovation, customer-centric service, and international expansion further differentiates it in the market.
